title: MZ Best plugins for adding in RPG Maker 2003 's features?

posts.author: JimFrom2003
posts.body:
I love RPG Maker MZ, there's loads of new features that were available in the 2003 version that are conspicuously absent in newer versions (plus, who doesn't love the chunky pixels of RM2K3?) So basically, I'm looking for plugins that will give RPG Maker MZ features that were available in RPG Maker 2003 but were dropped in newer versions. So far I have three:
Low-res graphics -
Pixel Perfect Scaling Mode
Low-res text -
OpenType Pixel Font Renderer
Call Map Event -
Template Events
If anyone knows of any plugins that add in more RM2K3 features (or do the same things at the three listed, but better) I'd love to hear. I'm particularly looking for a way to recreate RM2K3 image commands, where I could use variables to set the size and transparency of the image, use sprite sheets, animations, etc.
EDIT: I meant using sprite sheets and animations for the
pictures
. Also, I would enjoy the ability to mass-erase pictures and replace tiles.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
the image manipulations and variable operations should be doable without any plugin, just by using the script equivalents of the event commands - which are listed in a pinned topic.
MV style animations are available since update 1.4 or so by right-clicking on an animation slot and selecting "MV-compatible data"
for anything else, can you describe what exactly you want?
Because very few people are still using RM2K(3) and most have no idea what features were removed.

posts.author: JimFrom2003
posts.body:
I kinda meant being able to animate the images, but that is also helpful advice.
But as for other RM2K3 features I miss, the ability to mass-remove images would be helpful, especially since that can't easily be done with scripting. I would also make great use out of a command to replace individual tiles.
